title: Required change explanations
responsibility: Finds unit additions/removals, symbol changes and otherwise-unexplained declared-manifest changes that need reasons.

inputs.name: presentUnits.side
inputs.description: Contains a revision's file index and manifests, plus an optional writing-limits version. These functions use the file map and manifests only; writing does not affect their results.

inputs.name: requiredReasons.base
inputs.description: Contains the earlier revision's file index and manifests for comparison with the head revision. Its optional writing-limits value is ignored.

inputs.name: requiredReasons.head
inputs.description: Contains the later revision's file index and manifests for comparison with the base revision. Its optional writing-limits value is ignored.

inputs.name: reasonDeclarationHash.unit
inputs.description: A full component manifest or a compact manifest for one unit, used to fingerprint declared facts. Compact manifests return their stored declarationHash; full manifests are hashed from declared kind, responsibility, contract, dependencies, runtime, targets, scenarios, budgets, and lineage.

outputs.name: presentUnits
outputs.description: A Map keyed by unit ID containing manifests whose status is active and whose owns.source includes at least one path present in side.index.files.

outputs.name: requiredReasons
outputs.description: An array sorted by unit ID and then symbol, containing reasons for added or removed units or changed source blocks (* marks whole-unit changes). Same-name blocks with identical hashes remain unchanged across file moves, and <manifest> is emitted only when declared manifest data changes without symbol changes.

outputs.name: reasonDeclarationHash
outputs.description: Returns a compact manifest's stored declarationHash, or the first 16 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over the selected declared fields of a full manifest.
